## Design note

Godzilla. A heavy, wide, all-wheel-drive coupe whose rated 280 PS was a polite fiction: the twin-turbo six pulls to 8000 rpm and the ATTESA drivetrain puts it all down out of junctions where the rear-drive cars light their tyres. It understeers if you arrive too fast, then rotates on the throttle once the rear LSD bites. No 180 km/h limiter here: it runs on past 250 km/h.

## How this car breaks

Same 90s HSS shell as the GT-T, but with an aluminium bonnet and aluminium front wings that crumple and shed early, a front-mount intercooler and oil cooler packed behind a deep bumper, and an expensive AWD driveline under the floor. It shrugs off scrapes; a solid frontal takes the cooling pack and the front diff with it, and every part is priced like a legend.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 668 | 0.80 | 530 |
| pitch | 3050 | 0.88 | 2680 |
| yaw | 3227 | 0.90 | 2900 |

## Engine

RB26DETT 2.6 L DOHC 24-valve I6, twin ceramic-wheel ball-bearing turbos, intercooled, individual throttles. Rated 206 kW (280 PS) @ 6800 rpm, 392 N·m @ 4400 [S19][S20] under the JDM gentleman's agreement; real-world factor ×1.12: ≈439 N·m @ 4400 and ≈239 kW @ 6000 rpm (the [E] curve shape already carries 213 kW at 6000 before the factor). Stock cars dyno ≈240-250 kW at the crank and ≈200 kW at the wheels [S19?]; ×1.12 sits at the conservative end of those reports. Curve shape [E] on the rated points, boost from ≈3000 rpm.

## Drivetrain

Getrag 233 6-speed manual (FS6R92A), ATTESA E-TS (nominal 0:100, up to 50:50 when the rears slip) approximated as a fixed 30 % front split: the contract cannot express a rear-primary coupling yet (requested in docs/integration/cars.md); open front differential, mechanical 1.5-way rear LSD. Layout **AWD, 30 % front**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 100 N·m, power ramp 0.45, coast ramp 0.30. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 610 N·m. Shift time 0.42 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.83 | 13.57 | 70 |
| 2 | 2.36 | 8.37 | 114 |
| 3 | 1.69 | 5.97 | 160 |
| 4 | 1.31 | 4.65 | 205 |
| 5 | 1.00 | 3.54 | 270 |
| 6 | 0.79 | 2.81 | 340 |

Final drive 3.54, reverse 3.24. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.317 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 428 kg | 1.80 Hz | 54800 N/m | 2910 N·s/m | 4360 N·s/m | 0.14 m |
| Rear | 317 kg | 2.00 Hz | 50100 N/m | 2390 N·s/m | 3580 N·s/m | 0.15 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.2°/g with 54% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.373 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 151515 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 60010 F / 55571 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **10000 F / 6400 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.2°/g, front share 54%. Bump stops 170000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -1.5° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 5.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 324 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm + 42 mm → A = 25.2 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 137 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·25.2 cm²·0.137 m = **2900 N·m**
- Rear: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.125 m = **1134 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1845 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.57×), rear needs 627 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.80×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 986 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.534** → delivered 2900 N·m front / 986 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1600 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.6 m → outer-front path radius 5.68 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.27 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.558 rad (32.0°)** (outer 28.0°, inner 37.0° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.55). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.
